steps.label: Paket pruefen
steps.run: cd "$AGENT_HOME/pilot_test/film" && cat sr1_aa sr1_ab sr1_ac sr1_ad sr1_ae sr1_af sr1_ag > sr1.tgz && [ "$(md5 -q sr1.tgz)" = c83450532c87a5d24d919354ef43671f ] && rm -rf sr && mkdir sr && tar xzf sr1.tgz -C sr && rm -f sr1_a? && ls sr/bundle/public | wc -l

steps.label: Video rendern
steps.run: cd "$AGENT_HOME/pilot_test/film" && s=$(date +%s) && npx remotion render sr/bundle P sr_out1.mp4 --gl=angle --crf=18 --muted --concurrency=6 --timeout=180000 --log=error && e=$(date +%s) && echo "render_seconds $((e-s))" > sr_time1.txt

steps.label: Ton und Vorschau
steps.run: cd "$AGENT_HOME/pilot_test/film" && npx remotion ffmpeg -y -v error -i sr_out1.mp4 -i sr/mix.m4a -map 0:v -map 1:a -c copy -shortest sears_film1.mp4 && npx remotion ffmpeg -y -v error -i sears_film1.mp4 -c:v libx264 -crf 27 -preset veryfast -vf scale=1280:-2 -c:a copy sears_film1_vorschau.mp4 && tar czf sr1v.tgz sears_film1_vorschau.mp4 && ls -la sears_film1*.mp4 >> sr_time1.txt
